tasks.title: Mix: weight and offset to microseconds
tasks.statement: The mix source is at **{s} %**, the line weight is **{w} %**, the offset **{o} %**, Outputs limits at the defaults. What is the channel pulse width (µs)?
tasks.solution: p = s·weight/100 + offset (the offset is added after the weight), then the ±100 % limit and µs = 1500 + 5.12·p. Full travel is 988…2012 µs.

tasks.title: Percent to CRSF units
tasks.statement: The channel is at **{p} %**. What value does EdgeTX put into the CRSF frame (units 0…1984)?
tasks.solution: Internally ±100 % = ±1024; the frame gets 992 + out·4/5 = 992 + 8.192·p. The endpoints are 173 and 1811, the center 992. Betaflight shows 0.62477·crsf + 881 µs.

tasks.title: Expo in the radio
tasks.statement: Inputs has expo **{k}**, weight 100. The stick is deflected **{x} %**. What percentage does the mix get?
tasks.solution: y = k·x³ + (1 − k)·x, where x and y are fractions and k = expo/100. At expo 40 and 50 % stick, 35 %. For aircraft with a flight controller, expo in the radio stays at 0.

tasks.title: Capacity alarm threshold
tasks.statement: The battery is **{c} mAh**. The alarm should fire when **{r} %** of the capacity is used. What V2 value goes into the `a>x` logical switch on the Capa sensor (mAh)?
tasks.solution: V2 = capacity · fraction. For 1300 mAh and 80 %, 1040 mAh. Capa does not react to voltage sag, so this switch needs no delay.
